_readme: Radar rules: which entities the radar draws and how. The FIRST rule whose matcher accepts an entity decides; later rules are not consulted. Only living, non-player entities are candidates (other players are drawn as skin heads).

Edit a copy in config/sharedjourney/radar_rules/*.json, or ship your own assets/<namespace>/sharedjourney/radar_rules/*.json from a mod or resource pack. Rules of a later source are placed BEFORE these ones; a rule with the same 'id' replaces the rule in place, or removes it with "enabled": false; a file with "replace": true first discards every rule of lower priority. /sj radar reload re-reads the files in game.

Matcher (all given fields must match; a list means any of its values; absent = not tested): type (entity type id, or 'namespace:*'), tag (entity type tag id), kind (living | mob | enemy | animal | water_animal | villager | tamable), name (custom name glob, * and ?, case-insensitive), tamed (true | false, wolves / cats / parrots), owner (self | other, of a tamed animal).

Effect: category (hostile | passive | pets | villagers: the rule is hidden while the matching radar toggle is off; omit it for a rule no toggle controls), visible (false hides what the rule matches), color ("#RRGGBB" or "#AARRGGBB", the dot color; defaults to the category color), style (auto | dot: dot forces the colored dot instead of the head icon), iconScale (0.25 to 4, multiplies the head icon size).
A rule with an unknown key or an invalid value is logged and skipped. The four rules below reproduce the classic behavior: pet, then villager, then hostile, then any other mob.
